create_langsmith_logger: create a LangsmithLogger instance to log LLM events to LangSmith with configurable API key, project, and sampling rate
log_success_event: log a successful LLM completion event to LangSmith via LangsmithLogger.log_success_event or async_log_success_event
log_failure_event: log a failed LLM completion event to LangSmith via LangsmithLogger.async_log_failure_event with error details
send_batch_events: batch and send queued LangSmith log events to the LangSmith API via async_send_batch
get_run_by_id: retrieve a LangSmith run record by its run ID using get_run_by_id
